title: C:swim-divide with a label-free drive: c28's ringed Allen-Cahn cells under the local kernel drive (chi 5, mu 1.0, kd 0.08) keep a ring above the gate (labkit L 1.57-1.64), swim (36-47 ringed tracks >= 3 BL) and divide (224-244 persistent splits) from noise, until crowding jams them into a static lattice at t~5000
summary: A 16-setting screen at 128^2 shows a ring-motility trade-off under the local drive: chi raises the ring, mu restores motion but weakens the ring and brings merges back, and kd 0.08 suppresses merges. chi 5, mu 1.0, kd 0.08 holds all three. At 256^2 on 2 seeds: labkit L rim/core 1.64 and 1.57 (MEMBRANE-LIKE), 224-244 persistent splits, generation 5-6, merges 0.32-0.39 of splits. c28's contour ring score is >= 1.5 in 95% of cell-frames, 36-47 tracks swim >= 3 BL, all ringed, and 1-3 lineages per seed swim, keep the ring and divide (seed 1 #333: 5.1 BL, then splits into #730 and #731). mu=0 stops swimming (max 1.9 BL); chi=0 removes the ring (0.98) and cuts division 14x. The drive has no per-body labels. Limit: everything happens during colonization; after t~5000 the cells jam into a static lattice.

claims.statement: With WORLD_P {drive: kernel, mu: 1.0, kd: 0.08, chi: 5}, from smoothed noise over the whole 256^2 domain (seeds 0, 1), walled Allen-Cahn cells carry a ring of their own link product (labkit L rim/core 1.64/1.57; contour score >= 1.5 in 95% of cell-frames), swim under the label-free local drive (36/47 tracks >= 3 BL, all ringed) and divide (224/244 labkit persistent splits, generation 5-6); 1 and 3 lineages show all three in one track during colonization (t<5000).
claims.track: seed 1, ringtrack #333 (img/strip_s1_333.png, img/div_s1_333.png, data/rt_chi5mu10_s1.report.txt): born by a split at t=2360, swims 5.07 BL with the ring >= 1.5 in 95% of scored frames, divides at t~4580 into #730 and #731

controls_run.B: pack_chi0/ (chi=0, seed 0: L rim/core 0.98, 3/97 membrane-like; persistent splits 16 vs 224)
controls_run.M: pack_mu0/ (mu=0, seed 0: 6 tracks >= 1 BL, max 1.9 BL vs 101 tracks and 3.6 BL)

limits: Swimming and division happen during colonization only: by t~5000 the torus is full and the cells jam into a static lattice (pack/seed1/sheet.png t>=5200); the daughters of #333 move 3-14 px afterwards. Only 1-3 track segments per seed show swim + ring + divide, and most of #333's frames have no ring score (small cell); the ring fraction is over scored frames. The ring is chi-drift adsorption of the cell's own link product (L3 quasi-equilibrium clause; the cell makes all L). The mu=0 control changes the population too (14 vs 298 bodies). 2 seeds; no dt or resolution test; no Laplacian-only twin. chi 5 and kd 0.08 were chosen by screening seed 0 at 128^2.
